resources.name: Arav Gupta
resources.project: Paws for a Cause: Extending a Helping Hand to Our Furry Friends
resources.summary: "With Paws for the Cause, I strive to work towards bridging the gap between humans and dogs."
resources.nextSteps: As the project’s podcast series progresses we want to include experts on human-dog conflict in our conversations to provide more insightful perceptions to the mix for others to listen to. The next phase of our initiative will focus on data collection and public engagement. We will be conducting surveys at universities across the country to gather in-depth information on the scope and nature of this complex issue. Along with the surveys, we are developing a comprehensive web platform. This platform will consist of a website and a user-friendly web application. The web application will serve as a central hub for reporting human-dog conflict incidents. Users will be able to submit detailed reports, providing valuable information for researchers and policymakers working towards solutions. The website component will expand beyond conflict reporting. It will also serve as a platform for promoting positive human-dog interactions. We aim to promote adopting dogs rather than buying them hence, a page will be dedicated to showcase adoptable dogs from shelters across India . This page will include detailed information on each dog, along with contact information for the respective shelters.

resources.name: Tanay Sanghvi
resources.project: Blue Oasis: Revitalizing water, reviving life
resources.summary: "I'm dedicated to safeguarding our future by ensuring that water, our most crucial resource, remains available for the generations to come."
resources.nextSteps: With the project yielding positive results, I intend to expand the implementation of the floating islands to other lakes across the city. This initiative has demonstrated its potential to enhance local ecosystems and improve water quality, making it a valuable addition to our urban environment. To achieve this expansion, I will be hiring dedicated volunteers who can assist me in building more of these innovative floating islands. Their support will be crucial in increasing our reach and ensuring the success of the project. Additionally, I aim to raise funds from both local residents and companies. Engaging the community and businesses in this effort is essential to gather the necessary resources for the project's continuation and growth. By fostering a sense of collective responsibility and investment, we can secure the financial support required to extend the benefits of these floating islands to numerous lakes throughout the city, thereby creating a healthier and more sustainable environment for all.
